d:
From the most exciting combination of Anirudh and Vignesh ShivN, here is the extremely infectious, retro romance oozing “Naana Thaana”. This one is sure to give you the butterflies in your stomach and leave you humming this track for days to come!
Watch the official video here.
Song Name - Naana Thaana
Movie - Thaanaa Serndha Koottam
Singer - Anirudh Ravichander
Music - Anirudh Ravichander
Lyrics - Vignesh ShivN
Chorus - Ananthakrrishnan
